args.content:
Activity 5: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: The team is split into small groups and locked in a themed escape room. Groups must collaborate, communicate, and pool their different skills to solve a series of puzzles and escape before the time runs out.
  - Objective: To build trust, sharpen collaborative problem-solving, and highlight the value of diverse perspectives under time pressure.
  - Location: MindQuest Escape Rooms, Downtown
  - Date: 2024-06-12
  - Time: 15:00 - 17:00

Activity 6: Volunteering Day
  - Description: Team members spend a day volunteering together at a local community organization (e.g., a food bank, animal shelter, or park cleanup). Tasks are organized so that everyone contributes and works side by side.
  - Objective: To strengthen team bonds through shared purpose, boost morale, and give back to the community.
  - Location: Local community center
  - Date: 2024-06-26
  - Time: 09:30 - 13:30
